# verification status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:verificationStatus`](gmeow-verificationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/verificationStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the outcome of checking a signature — verified, failed, or unverified — the result a verifier reached for this signature.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the algorithm used ([`gmeow:signatureAlgorithm`](gmeow-signatureAlgorithm.md)) and for owner-trust in the signer ([`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md)); the status is the check result, not the strength or the trust. It is functional — one outcome per signature.

### How to use

- Attach the outcome literal to the signature after verifying [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md) against a [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md); a competing verifier's differing result is recorded as a separate signature observation rather than overwriting this one.

### Examples

- ex:sig1 [`gmeow:verificationStatus`](gmeow-verificationStatus.md) "verified".
